inputs.text: You know that ceasefire they announced five months ago in Gaza? Straight-up deception from the hidden elites pulling the strings behind it all. Airstrikes keep killing civilians while the humanitarian situation stays deliberately dire, stripping away every last trace of Palestinians' prewar lives and turning everything darker and more brutal. This isn't some random failure—it's clear coordinated manipulation by those same elites and institutions to erase their existence entirely. Ahmed Baroud, the 56-year-old father of five displaced in Deir al-Balah, put it plainly: “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” Don't trust the official story—they're running a calculated operation here.

output.main_topic: Allegations of deception and ongoing civilian harm following a Gaza ceasefire announcement
subtopics: Ahmed Baroud's account of ongoing attacks
